name: webflowmaster-promo-video
description: The 60-second WebFlowMaster promo video, written with Remotion.

scripts.render:all: npm run render:en && npm run render:it
scripts.render:en:music: remotion render PromoEN out/webflowmaster-promo-en.mp4 --props=props-music.json && node ../audio/finalize.mjs en
scripts.render:it:music: remotion render PromoIT out/webflowmaster-promo-it.mp4 --props=props-music.json && node ../audio/finalize.mjs it
scripts.render:all:music: npm run audio:generate && npm run render:en:music && npm run render:it:music
